```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(gfplot::theme_pbs())
```

$\beta_{trend} = log(\lambda) = \frac{log{I_{t}} - log{I_{0}}}{t}$

$I_{t}$ = Index of biomass or stock status at time $t$
$I_{0}$ = Index of biomass or stock status at last assessment year $0$
$t$ = Time

# Pacific Cod

```{r}
# Recovery rate estimation from posterior CIs
# Uses a surplus production model using h and M to estimate r,
# then propagates uncertainty via Monte Carlo sampling from posterior CIs.
logit <- function(x) log(x / (1 - x))
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

recovery_rate <- function(h, M, B0 = 1, depletion, years = 25, dt = 0.02) {
  # BH production model in depletion units (x = B/B0); B0 cancels.
  phi <- 4 * h / (1 - h) # alpha / M
  x <- depletion # starting depletion
  nsteps <- round(years / dt)
  # Euler integration:
  for (i in seq_len(nsteps)) {
    dxdt <- M * x * (phi / (1 + (phi - 1) * x) - 1)
    x <- x + dxdt * dt
    x <- min(x, 1) # can't exceed B0
  }
  log(x / depletion) / years # average instantaneous rate over years
}

# Monte Carlo sampling from posterior CIs
# Parameters from Tables 8 & 9 (2.5%, median, 97.5%):
#   h:          0.432, 0.727, 0.931   (Table 8)
#   M:          0.280, 0.312, 0.347   (Table 8)
#   B2019/B0:   0.45,  0.58,  0.92   (Table 9) — use ratio directly to
#                                      capture correlation between B0 and Bcurrent
#
# h, depletion: logit-normal (bounded 0-1)
# M:            lognormal    (positive, right-skewed)
# SD estimated as (hi - lo) / 3.92  [= (97.5th - 2.5th) / (2 * 1.96)]

n <- 5000
set.seed(42)
# h must be > 0.2 (BH biological minimum); replace any invalid draws
h_sd <- (logit(0.931) - logit(0.432)) / 3.92
h_s <- inv_logit(rnorm(n, mean = logit(0.727), sd = h_sd))
while (any(h_s <= 0.2)) {
  bad <- h_s <= 0.2
  h_s[bad] <- inv_logit(rnorm(sum(bad), mean = logit(0.727), sd = h_sd))
}
# h_s <- rep(mean(h_s), length(h_s))
M_s <- rlnorm(n,
  meanlog = log(0.312),
  sdlog   = (log(0.347) - log(0.280)) / 3.92
)
# M_s <- rep(mean(M_s), length(M_s))
dep_s <- inv_logit(rnorm(n,
  mean = logit(0.58),
  sd   = (logit(0.92) - logit(0.45)) / 3.92
))
rates <- mapply(recovery_rate, h = h_s, M = M_s, depletion = dep_s)
x <- quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
print(x)

# hist(rates, breaks = 60,
#   main = "Recovery rate posterior", xlab = "beta (yr-1)")
# abline(v = quantile(rates, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)), lty = c(2, 1, 2), col = "red")
pcod_rates <- data.frame(
  species = "pacific cod",
  source = "Table 8 and 9 + calculations",
  case = c("5% rate", "50% rate", "95% rate"),
  time = 25,
  lambda = exp(as.numeric(x)),
  citekey = "forrest2020",
  reference = NA_character_,
  notes = "Logistic growth calculations based on parameter posteriors",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
h_sd <- (logit(0.9508) - logit(0.5659)) / 3.29
h_s  <- inv_logit(rnorm(n, mean = logit(0.7958), sd = h_sd))
while (any(h_s <= 0.2)) {
  bad      <- h_s <= 0.2
  h_s[bad] <- inv_logit(rnorm(sum(bad), mean = logit(0.7958), sd = h_sd))
}
M_s <- rlnorm(n,
  meanlog = log(0.09329),
  sdlog   = (log(0.1063) - log(0.08094)) / 3.29
)
dep_s <- rlnorm(n,
  meanlog = log(0.7780),
  sdlog   = (log(1.0450) - log(0.5703)) / 3.29
)
rates <- mapply(recovery_rate, h = h_s, M = M_s, depletion = dep_s)
print(round(quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 4))
# hist(rates, breaks = 60,
#   main = "Recovery rate posterior — Canary Rockfish", xlab = "beta (yr-1)")
# abline(v = quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), lty = c(2, 1, 2), col = "red")
x <- quantile(rates, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
exp(x)
```

```{r}
  sd   = (logit(0.698) - logit(0.405)) / 3.29
))

rates <- mapply(recovery_rate, h = h_s, M = M_s, depletion = dep_s)

# cat("Recovery rate beta (yr-1), 25-year no-fishing projection:\n")
print(round(quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 4))

hist(rates, breaks = 60,
  main = "Recovery rate posterior — Silvergray Rockfish", xlab = "beta (yr-1)")
abline(v = quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), lty = c(2, 1, 2), col = "red")

x <- quantile(rates, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
x
exp(x)
# hist(exp(rates))

silvergray_rates <- data.frame(
  species = "silvergray rockfish",
  source = "Table 2 and 3 + calculations",
  case = c("5% rate", "50% rate", "95% rate"),
  time = 25,
  lambda = exp(x),
  citekey = NA_character_,
  reference = NA_character_,
  notes = "Logistic growth calculations based on parameter posteriors; female M used",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Outside yelloweye rockfish

```{r}
set.seed(42)
M_s <- rlnorm(n,
  meanlog = log(0.034),
  sdlog   = (log(0.035) - log(0.030)) / 3.92
)

h_sd <- (logit(0.87) - logit(0.49)) / 3.92
h_s  <- inv_logit(rnorm(n, mean = logit(0.71), sd = h_sd))
while (any(h_s <= 0.2)) {
  bad      <- h_s <= 0.2
  h_s[bad] <- inv_logit(rnorm(sum(bad), mean = logit(0.71), sd = h_sd))
}

dep_s <- inv_logit(rnorm(n,
  mean = logit(0.45),
  sd   = (logit(0.67) - logit(0.27)) / 3.92
))

rates <- mapply(recovery_rate, h = h_s, M = M_s, depletion = dep_s)

print(round(quantile(rates, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 5))
x <- quantile(rates, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))

# hist(rates, breaks = 60,
#   main = "Recovery rate posterior — Yelloweye Rockfish (Coastwide, wtd)",
#   xlab = "beta (yr-1)")
# abline(v = x, lty = c(2, 1, 2), col = "red")

# ---- Output data frame -------------------------------------------------------
ye_rates_outside <- data.frame(
  species   = "yelloweye rockfish",
  source    = "Table 6 & 7 (Coastwide) — wtd",
  case      = c("5% rate", "50% rate", "95% rate"),
  time      = 25,
  lambda    = exp(x),
  citekey   = "doherty2026",
  reference = NA_character_,
  notes     = "Newer assessment; weighted OM; logistic growth from posterior 95% CIs",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
rates <- bind_rows(ling_rates, qb_rates, dog_rates, 
  #ye_rates, 
  halibut_rates, pcod_rates, canary_rates, silvergray_rates, ye_rates_outside) |>
  arrange(species, lambda) |>
  mutate(lambda = round(lambda, 4))

saveRDS(rates, here::here("data-generated", "recovery-rates-lambda.rds"))

rates <- readRDS(here::here("data-generated", "recovery-rates-lambda.rds"))
```
